# Research notes with an evidence trail

Each claim should point to the passage that supports it, with a source address and capture date. Keep the excerpt and your analysis in distinct blocks. If the source changes, annotate the new state while preserving what was actually read before.

An evidence table can connect several sources to one conclusion without turning their wording into an apparent consensus. Mark unresolved contradictions instead of smoothing them away. A useful note tells a future reader which statements are quotations, which are paraphrases and which are the author's own inferences.
